versions.changelog:
Initial release of Guangdong Computing Policy skill:

- Aggregates the latest national and Guangdong (including Guangzhou, Shenzhen) policies on computing power and AI, covering large models, intelligent computing centers, data centers, and related government bonds.
- Offers structured policy briefings triggered by specific keywords related to Guangdong and AI computing policy.
- Focuses on timely (last 30 days) and relevant policy updates, filtering out outdated and unrelated information.
- Organizes policy content by issuing authority, with output that summarizes key points, publication date, and source link.
- Ensures reliable sourcing by prioritizing government sites and authoritative media, and provides clear user notifications when no new policies are found.
